response.summary: A medium severity bent defect was detected. The affected area is 1.2 percent.
likely_causes: Mechanical impact during handling, stacking or depaneling.
Pick-and-place nozzle pressing the part off-centre.
Damaged component reels or trays from the supplier.
response.recommended_action: rework: Re-inspect the board on the camera station after rework. Treat as high severity and reject if a lead touches a neighbouring lead or pad, or a lead is cracked or lifted.

sources.snippet: rework: straighten or replace the component, then re-inspect the board on the camera station.
Line lead, if more than 3 bent-lead boards appear within 30 minutes (handling problem). Process engineer, if the bent leads are always on the same component (placement or supplier problem).

response.summary: High severity melt defect detected. The area affected is 4.1 percent.
likely_causes: Reflow oven temperature profile too hot or conveyor too slow.
Manual soldering iron held too long on the part during rework.
Heat-sensitive component placed on the wrong side or too close to a hot part.

sources.snippet: reject. Heat damage to the board itself cannot be repaired reliably.

Process engineer, immediately, if 2 or more melt defects appear within 30 minutes: check the reflow oven profile before more boards pass. See QC-6.1 for stop-line rules. Rework station lead, if melt defects appear only on reworked boards.

response.summary: A low severity scratch was detected. The area affected is 0.4 percent.
likely_causes: Boards sliding against each other or against fixtures during handling.
Worn or dirty conveyor rails or magazine slots.
Tools or tweezers during manual rework.
response.recommended_action: accept: Accept only if purely cosmetic with no exposed copper and no damage to assembly markings. Reject if a trace is cut, damaged, or if the scratch crosses several traces.

sources.snippet: accept if purely cosmetic: no exposed copper and no damage to markings needed for assembly.
Line lead, if scratches repeat in the same place on the board: check conveyor rails and fixtures.

response.summary: A missing component was detected. This is a high severity defect.
likely_causes: Wrong or missing component in the placement program.
response.recommended_action: reject: Rework instead only if the rework station can place and solder the part; re-inspect afterwards.

sources.snippet: reject, or rework only if the rework station can place and solder the missing part and the board is re-inspected afterwards.
Machine operator of the pick-and-place, immediately: check the feeder for that position. Stop the line if the same position is missing on 2 consecutive boards (QC-6.1).

response.summary: An unknown defect was detected. A technician must inspect the board before any decision is made.
response.recommended_action: review: Never accept automatically: a technician inspects the board and records what the defect actually was.

sources.snippet: Never accept automatically. A technician inspects the board in person. The technician decides accept, rework or reject, and records what the defect actually was. If the same unknown defect appears on several boards, treat it as a new defect type and inform the QA engineer.
QA engineer, for every unknown defect that turns out to be real.

cases.name: question_why
cases.question: Why is this board rejected, and who should I call?

response.summary: A component is missing. This is a high severity defect.
likely_causes: Wrong or missing component in the placement program.
response.recommended_action: reject: Rework instead only if the rework station can place and solder the part; re-inspect afterwards.
response.answer: The board is rejected because a missing component is always high severity (QC-4.3). Call the machine operator of the pick-and-place immediately to check the feeder (QC-4.4).

sources.snippet: reject, or rework only if the rework station can place and solder the missing part and the board is re-inspected afterwards.
Machine operator of the pick-and-place, immediately: check the feeder for that position. Stop the line if the same position is missing on 2 consecutive boards (QC-6.1).

response.answer: I can't give a checked answer to that. The decision comes from the QC manual: reject (QC-2.3). Please ask a technician if you disagree.
